label: July 13–19, 2026
intro: Stacked weekend: live magicians from 4 countries, Disney magic on Rama VIII at dawn, AND the Furryways closes Sunday — three reasons to go out.

activities.title: Thailand Magic Arts Festival 2026
activities.why: Real magicians from Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Thailand — live shows, competitions, and interactive sessions across two days. The one-hour Magic Theatre production is perfect for a 5-year-old: pure spectacle, right-sized attention span.
activities.tip: Book the Magic Theatre Full Show in advance — it's the best standalone chunk for kids.

activities.title: MRKREME: The Furryways — LAST DAY
activities.why: A make-believe subway station packed with giant huggable monster sculptures — completely free, completely tactile. Thor can hug, squeeze, and explore Mushkin and friends. Last chance before the Asia tour moves on.
activities.tip: Go before noon to beat the Sunday crowd.

activities.title: Disney Run Thailand 2026
activities.price: 800–1,000 THB to run; free to spectate
activities.why: Thailand's very first Disney Run — 30,000+ runners in mouse ears crossing Rama VIII Bridge at sunrise. The Disney theming, character costumes, and festival atmosphere are magical even as a spectator.
activities.tip: The races start at 4–5am (very early for Thor). Spectating from the riverside around 6–7am when finishers roll in is a better bet — free and still buzzing with Disney energy.

activities.title: Neo Land Festival
activities.why: Immersive contemporary Thai art installations — walk-through, large-scale, and weird in the best way for a curious 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Pair with a boat ride along the Chao Phraya outside ICONSIAM.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Chocolate Workshop
activities.why: Thor loved making chocolate — Kad Kokoa's dedicated kids bonbon workshop is real craft chocolate, not just dipping. Small group, proper chef skills.
activities.tip: Dates sell fast. Check kadkokoa.co and follow their LINE Official for upcoming July slots.

activities.title: Clay Circle Pottery Session
activities.why: Pottery was a hit — Clay Circle welcomes kids for hands-on clay sessions. Squish, shape, glaze, and pick up the masterpiece a few days later.
